text:
marta (People Ops): Quick heads-up — candidate Ana M for SRE onsite has a timezone conflict. Original panel is 9am PT / 5pm BST; Jordan just pinged that 9am PT won't work. Can someone swap into the 11am PT slot or should we shift the whole panel? Also small rubric addendum: please score "system design troubleshooting" as REQUIRED for this round (see bullets below).

jordan (Hiring Manager): Sorry, running over with exec comms. I can’t do 9am. I *might* be able to join 12pm PT but not guaranteed. Prefer not to shift candidate multiple times.

devin (ML Infra): I can cover the 11am PT slot if that helps, but I won’t be able to do whiteboard portion — happy to do hands-on questions and be the second interviewer.

rebecca (Interviewer): I can hop in as debrief lead if @devin covers 11am. I’ll capture notes and normalize scores. :+1: 

marta (People Ops): Great — plan: move Jordan off 9am, Devin -> 11am interviewer, Rebecca -> debrief lead. I’ll update the calendar and the rubric doc.

peopleops-bot: Calendar updated — new event time for panel: 11:00 PT. Invite (updated) sent to panel + candidate. Recording + transcript enabled.

marta (People Ops): Rubric addendum (quick paste to save time):
```
- Required anchor: System design troubleshooting (debugging given incident timeline)
- Score weight: +2 priority on system design for this round
- Notes: If candidate can't reproduce live whiteboard, use the incident prompt and ask follow-ups listed in doc
```

rebecca (Interviewer): Thanks — can you link the live rubric doc? I want to add two sample follow-ups.

marta (People Ops): Linking: https://redwood.example.com/internal/rubrics/sre-onsite (team-only). Adding sample follow-ups now.

devin (ML Infra): one practical ask: if we can’t do live sysdiag, please give the candidate 5 mins to read the incident prompt before Qs. That makes scoring fair.

marta (People Ops): Noted — adding a line under "logistics" to instruct 5m reading buffer if whiteboard not possible.

jordan (Hiring Manager): Appreciate you all stepping in. If anything changes I’ll DM Marta. Good luck with Ana.

marta (People Ops): Final: Devin confirmed for 11am, Rebecca is debrief lead, I updated rubric + event. I’ll drop a 15-min pre-panel ping with fresh links and the candidate resume. Thanks everyone. :heart:
